statement: Bound, non-circular dependency lock. The 32 artifacts (names, versions, filenames, official URLs, sizes, the 31 publisher-declared SHA-256 values and the complete Requires-Dist graph) are read from the exact Git blob named in `source`, never transcribed. torchvision's wheel digest is a local-sha256-TOFU record bound to an exact published independent receipt that the harness re-reads and checks. The lock never names the review that accepts it; the coordinator release record binds accepted review, harness code, protocol and lock identities and the accepted provenance exception.

metadata_digest_source.role: Published PEP 658 METADATA digests (and recorded bodies) from the official PyTorch cu130 index; acquired torch/torchvision wheels must carry exactly that METADATA

cuda.torch_cuda_version_basis: source inference from the +cu130 local version; must be observed as torch.version.cuda in the released runtime precheck

triton_policy_basis: No triton/flash-attn/xformers artifact in the 32-artifact graph. The strict Q0 baseline is the unmodified model on its native non-Triton fallback path (Q0R-04): find_spec('triton') must be None and is recorded.
bootstrap_tooling_note: pip is the venv-bundled installer of the exact interpreter; its version is recorded at venv creation and never upgraded. It is outside the 32 runtime artifacts.

hash_gaps.name: torchvision
hash_gaps.reason: Neither official PyTorch index (combined /whl/torchvision/ or /whl/cu130/torchvision/) publishes a wheel SHA-256 (Astra /007 torchvision-alternate-indexes.json). The PEP 658 digest authenticates METADATA only; the multipart ETag is not a content digest.
hash_gaps.resolution: Bound below to exactly one published independent receipt as a local_hash_records entry with hash_kind local-sha256-TOFU. Never relabelled publisher-verified. Installation additionally requires the install release record to list 'torchvision-local-sha256-TOFU' in accepted_provenance_exceptions (coordinator acceptance for bounded local Q0 is recorded in docs/kickoffs/WP-0005-resume-2026-11-15.md, not in this lock).

local_hash_records.name: torchvision

receipt.author: eld-q0-reviewer (independent observer acquisition; not harness author)

limits: Trust-on-first-use: proves later copies equal the bytes received over TLS from the official origin (Cloudflare edge HIT, HTTP 200, no redirects) at acquisition time; not publisher intent.
The PEP 658 METADATA match authenticates only the METADATA member, not the other 214 ZIP members.
local_hash_records.receipt_errata: Receipt field etag_matches_recorded_head=false is a disclosed reviewer reporting defect (N-03: lowercase 'etag' header key looked up as 'ETag'); the ETag strings are byte-identical and an ETag is not a content digest. The harness ignores that field; the receipt is preserved unchanged.
